records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the March 2022 quarter, revenue decreased 4% compared to the December 2021 quarter as a result of continued supplier-related delays in an already heavily constrained supply-chain environment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The wafer fabrication equipment demand environment is strong in calendar year 2022 driven by increasing device manufacturing complexity and the robust secular demand for semiconductors for NAND, DRAM, and foundry logic markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the quarter-ended March 27, 2022, customer demand remained solid; however, ongoing supply chain constraints broadened during the quarter and impacted our ability to fulfill demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in operating expenses in the March 2022 quarter compared to the December 2021 quarter was primarily driven by decreases in variable compensation, partially offset by increases in employee-related costs from seasonality and increased headcount.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This decrease was primarily the result of $1.3 billion of share repurchases, including net share settlement on employee stock-based compensation; $210.6 million of dividends paid to stockholders; and $145.4 million of capital expenditures, partially offset by $757.7 million of cash generated from operating activities.
